Home.title: Prepare for Aptis ESOL General and reach C
Home.lead: Lessons, practice for all 18 parts and timed mock exams, designed for Spanish speakers.
Home.partsLead: Each part is a border: master it and you earn its stamp.
Home.levelsLead: Every level you reach gets stamped: A2, B1, B2 and C.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Your estimated level for each skill, your streak and your next recommended task.

placementTest.title: Placement test
placementTest.lead: About 20 minutes of grammar, vocabulary, reading and listening to estimate your level and build your study plan.

syllabus.title: Syllabus
syllabus.lead: Grammar, vocabulary and strategies for every part of the exam, from A2 to C1.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.lead: Lessons from A2 to C1 with the typical mistakes Spanish speakers make and self-marking practice.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.lead: Collocations, false friends, register and the vocabulary of the topics the exam usually covers.

reading.title: Reading
reading.lead: All four reading parts, with strategies and original texts.

listening.title: Listening
listening.lead: Audio with British voices, transcripts and practice in picking up attitude and intention.

writing.title: Writing
writing.lead: An editor with a live word count, annotated B2 and C models, and formal and informal templates.

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.lead: Recording, timers and model answers for all four parts.

practice.title: Practice
practice.lead: A trainer for each of the 18 parts of the exam.

mockExam.title: Mock exam
mockExam.lead: The full exam with real timings and a report for each skill at the end.

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.lead: Vocabulary with spaced repetition: each word comes back just before you forget it.

mistakes.title: Mistakes
mistakes.lead: Your mistakes, saved so you can practise them again later.

examGuide.title: Exam guide
examGuide.lead: Format, timings, scoring and tips for every part.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Language and theme. Later on, also the listening voice, your exam date and a backup of your progress.

Legal.title: Legal notice
Legal.lead: Who is behind Sello and what you can expect from its content.
Legal.unofficialBody: Sello is an independent project to help you prepare for Aptis ESOL General. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the British Council, and it does not use its brand, logo or materials.
Legal.contentBody: All lessons, texts, audio and questions are original. They follow the format of the exam but do not copy official or third-party materials.
Legal.estimatesBody: The levels and scores shown in the app are our own estimates, not official results.
Legal.ownerBody: The owner’s details will be added before the website is published.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.lead: What data Sello stores and where.
Privacy.storedBody: Your theme preference and your progress (sessions, scores and mistakes to review), in your browser's local storage. Nothing leaves your device.
Privacy.notStoredBody: We don’t use cookies, analytics or user accounts.
Privacy.deleteBody: In Settings you can export or delete your progress. It also disappears if you clear this site's data in your browser.

ExamGuide.formatLead: Five components. Each part has its own format, and Sello's trainers copy it.
ExamGuide.core: 25 grammar questions with 3 options and 25 vocabulary questions of 4 types.
ExamGuide.reading: Gapped sentences, putting a text in order, matching opinions and headings for a long text.
ExamGuide.listening: Specific information, matching speakers, opinions in a dialogue and attitude in a monologue. You can hear each recording once or twice.
ExamGuide.writing: Single words, a 20–30 word text, three 30–40 word answers and two emails: an informal one of 40–50 words and a formal one of 120–150.
ExamGuide.speaking: Personal questions, describing a photo, comparing two pictures and discussing an abstract topic after a minute to prepare.
ExamGuide.scoringBody: Each skill is scored from 0 to 50 and gets its own CEFR level. Scores can't be compared across skills, because the thresholds differ from one to another.
ExamGuide.coreTitle: Why Core can save a C
ExamGuide.coreBody: Grammar and Vocabulary are reported as a number from 0 to 50, with no level. But when a skill falls just below the threshold for a level, the Core score decides whether you get the higher level. Raising your Core score is the cheapest way to secure a C.
ExamGuide.estimateNote: Sello shows levels and scores estimated by the app. They are not official results.

Functional.title: Functional language
Functional.lead: Phrases for Writing parts 3 and 4 and for Speaking: how to give an opinion, hedge, contrast, conclude or buy time, with their level and register.
Functional.emptyBody: Functional phrases arrive with this phase's content.

highlight.hint: Tap a sentence to mark or unmark it.

instructions.reading-1: Choose the word that completes each sentence.
instructions.reading-2: Put the sentences in order to make a text. The first one is already in place.
instructions.reading-3: Read what each person says and choose who expresses each idea. You can choose the same person more than once.
instructions.reading-4: Choose the heading for each paragraph. There is one heading you do not need.
